name: Aaron
description: Brother of Moses and first High Priest of Israel, founder of the Aaronic priesthood.

name: Abel
description: Second son of Adam and Eve, a shepherd whose offering God accepted, murdered by his brother Cain.

name: Abigail
description: Wise wife of Nabal who averted David's anger, later becoming one of David's wives.

name: Abijam
description: Son of Rehoboam and king of Judah who fought against Jeroboam.

name: Abraham
description: Patriarch called by God out of Ur to Canaan, with whom God made a covenant promising countless descendants; father of Isaac and Ishmael.

name: Adam
description: The first man, formed from the dust of the earth and placed in the Garden of Eden, whose disobedience brought about the Fall.

name: Agabus
description: Prophet of the early Church who foretold a great famine and Paul's arrest in Jerusalem.

name: Agur
description: Son of Jakeh, to whom the sayings of Proverbs chapter 30 are attributed.

name: Ahab
description: King of Israel who, with his wife Jezebel, promoted the worship of Baal and was opposed by Elijah.

name: Ahaz
description: King of Judah who turned to Assyria for help against Israel and Syria, ignoring Isaiah's counsel.

name: Ahaziah of Israel
description: Son of Ahab who died after a fall, having sought an oracle from Baal-zebub.

name: Ahaziah of Judah
description: King of Judah killed by Jehu during his revolt against the house of Ahab.

name: Ahijah
description: Prophet of Shiloh who foretold the division of the kingdom by tearing his cloak into twelve pieces before Jeroboam.

name: Alexander the Great
description: King of Macedon whose conquest of the Persian Empire opens the First Book of Maccabees.

name: Amaziah
description: King of Judah who defeated Edom but was then routed by Jehoash of Israel.

name: Amminadab
description: Son of Ram and father of Nahshon, whose daughter Elisheba married Aaron.

name: Amon
description: Son of Manasseh, assassinated by his servants after a two-year reign.

name: Amos
description: Shepherd of Tekoa who prophesied against social injustice in the northern kingdom.

name: Amoz
description: Father of the prophet Isaiah.

name: Andrew
description: Fisherman of Bethsaida, brother of Simon Peter and the first apostle called by Jesus.

name: Anna
description: Aged prophetess who recognised the infant Jesus at his presentation in the Temple.

name: Annas
description: First High Priest of Roman Judaea and father-in-law of Caiaphas, before whom Jesus was first brought.

name: Antiochus III the Great
description: Seleucid king who took Judaea from the Ptolemies and was defeated by Rome at Magnesia.

name: Antiochus IV Epiphanes
description: Seleucid king whose desecration of the Temple and persecution of the Jews provoked the Maccabean revolt.

name: Apollos
description: Eloquent Jewish Christian of Alexandria who taught in Ephesus and Corinth.

name: Aquila
description: Jewish tentmaker from Pontus who, with his wife Priscilla, worked alongside Paul.

name: Arpachshad
description: Son of Shem, born two years after the Flood, in the line leading to Abraham.

name: Asa
description: King of Judah who removed idols from the land and reigned for forty-one years.

name: Asher
description: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, ancestor of the tribe of Asher along the northern coast.

name: Astyages
description: Last king of the Medes, mentioned at the opening of the story of Bel and the Dragon.

name: Athaliah
description: Daughter of Ahab who seized the throne of Judah, the only reigning queen of Judah, until overthrown by the priest Jehoiada.

name: Augustus
description: First Roman emperor, whose decree of a census brought Joseph and Mary to Bethlehem.

name: Azariah (prophet)
description: Son of Oded who encouraged King Asa to carry out religious reforms.

name: Baasha
description: King of Israel who seized the throne by killing Nadab and wiped out the house of Jeroboam.

name: Balaam
description: Non-Israelite seer hired by Balak of Moab to curse Israel, who instead blessed them after his donkey spoke.

name: Barnabas
description: Levite of Cyprus, companion of Paul on his first missionary journey.

name: Bartholomew
description: Apostle commonly identified with Nathanael of Cana, in whom Jesus said there was no guile.

name: Baruch
description: Scribe and companion of Jeremiah, to whom the Book of Baruch is attributed.

name: Beeri
description: Father of the prophet Hosea.

name: Benjamin
description: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel, ancestor of the tribe of Benjamin, from which came King Saul and the apostle Paul.

name: Beor
description: Father of the seer Balaam.

name: Boaz
description: Wealthy landowner of Bethlehem who married Ruth the Moabite as her kinsman-redeemer; great-grandfather of David.

name: Buzi
description: Priest and father of the prophet Ezekiel.

name: Caiaphas
description: High Priest who presided over the Sanhedrin at the trial of Jesus.

name: Cainan
description: Son of Arphaxad found in the Septuagint and Luke's genealogy but absent from the Masoretic text.

name: Claudius
description: Roman emperor who expelled the Jews from Rome and in whose reign Agabus' famine occurred.

name: Cleopas
description: Disciple who met the risen Jesus on the road to Emmaus, often identified with Clopas.

name: Dan
description: Son of Jacob and Bilhah, ancestor of the tribe of Dan, which later settled in the far north.

name: Daniel
description: Judaean exile in Babylon who interpreted dreams for Nebuchadnezzar and survived the lions' den.

name: Darius III
description: Last king of the Achaemenid Persian Empire, defeated by Alexander the Great.

name: David
description: Shepherd boy who slew Goliath and became king of a united Israel, making Jerusalem his capital; traditional author of many Psalms.

name: Deborah
description: Prophetess and judge of Israel who, with Barak, led the victory over the Canaanite general Sisera.

name: Dionysius the Areopagite
description: Member of the Areopagus in Athens converted by Paul's preaching.

name: Drusilla
description: Daughter of Herod Agrippa I and wife of Felix, who heard Paul speak of faith in Christ.

name: Eber
description: Great-grandson of Shem, traditionally regarded as the eponymous ancestor of the Hebrews.

name: Elah
description: Son of Baasha, killed while drunk in Tirzah by his officer Zimri.

name: Eldad
description: One of the seventy elders who prophesied in the Israelite camp, prompting Moses to wish all the Lord's people were prophets.

name: Eleazar
description: Son of Aaron who succeeded him as High Priest and helped Joshua divide the land of Canaan.

name: Eleazar Avaran
description: Son of Mattathias who died at Beth-zechariah beneath a war elephant he had stabbed.

name: Eli
description: High Priest at Shiloh who raised the young Samuel.

name: Eliezer ben Dodavah
description: Prophet who foretold the wreck of the ships Jehoshaphat built with Ahaziah of Israel.

name: Elijah
description: Fiery prophet of the northern kingdom who confronted Ahab and the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel and was taken up to heaven in a whirlwind.

name: Elisha
description: Disciple and successor of Elijah, renowned for many miracles including the healing of Naaman the Syrian.

name: Elkanah
description: Ephraimite husband of Hannah and father of the prophet Samuel.

name: Enoch
description: Son of Jared who walked with God and was taken up without dying; also venerated as a prophet.

name: Enos
description: Son of Seth and grandson of Adam, in whose days men began to call upon the name of the Lord.

name: Epaphras
description: Founder of the church at Colossae and fellow prisoner of Paul.

name: Ephraim
description: Younger son of Joseph, blessed above his brother by Jacob, ancestor of the leading tribe of the northern kingdom.

name: Esther
description: Jewish queen of Persia who risked her life to save her people from Haman's decree, commemorated at Purim.

name: Ezekiel
description: Priest and prophet among the exiles in Babylon, known for his visions of the divine chariot and the valley of dry bones.

name: Ezra
description: Priest and scribe who led a return from Babylon and re-established the Law in Jerusalem.

name: Felix
description: Roman governor of Judaea who heard Paul's case at Caesarea and kept him imprisoned.

name: Gad
description: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, ancestor of the tribe of Gad in Gilead east of the Jordan.

name: Gad (prophet)
description: Seer and prophet in the court of King David.

name: Gideon
description: Judge of Israel who, with only three hundred men, defeated the Midianites.

name: Habakkuk
description: Minor prophet who questioned God about injustice and the rise of the Chaldeans.

name: Haggai
description: Post-exilic prophet who urged the returned exiles to rebuild the Temple.

name: Hanani
description: Seer who rebuked King Asa of Judah for relying on Syria rather than the Lord.

name: Hannah
description: Mother of Samuel, whose prayer for a child at Shiloh was answered and whose song of thanksgiving is preserved in 1 Samuel.

name: Herod Agrippa I
description: King of Judaea who executed James son of Zebedee and imprisoned Peter, dying suddenly at Caesarea.

name: Herod Agrippa II
description: King before whom Paul made his defence in Acts 26.

name: Herod Antipas
description: Tetrarch of Galilee and Peraea who beheaded John the Baptist and took part in the trial of Jesus.

name: Herod the Great
description: Client king of Judaea under Rome who rebuilt the Temple and ordered the massacre of the innocents at Bethlehem.

name: Herodias
description: Wife of Herod Antipas who demanded the head of John the Baptist.

name: Hezekiah
description: Reforming king of Judah who withstood the Assyrian siege of Jerusalem under Sennacherib.

name: Hezron
description: Son of Perez and grandson of Judah, in the line of David.

name: Hosea
description: Minor prophet of the northern kingdom whose marriage to the unfaithful Gomer symbolised Israel's unfaithfulness to God.

name: Hoshea
description: Last king of Israel, during whose reign Samaria fell to Assyria and the people were carried into exile.

name: Huldah
description: Prophetess consulted by King Josiah after the discovery of the Book of the Law in the Temple.

name: Iddo
description: Seer whose writings on the reigns of Solomon, Rehoboam and Abijah are cited in Chronicles.

name: Isaac
description: Son of Abraham and Sarah, born in their old age and nearly offered as a sacrifice on Mount Moriah; father of Jacob and Esau.

name: Isaiah
description: Major prophet of eighth-century Judah who counselled Hezekiah and foretold the coming of Immanuel and the Suffering Servant.

name: Ish-bosheth
description: Son of Saul who briefly ruled the northern tribes after his father's death before being assassinated.

name: Issachar
description: Fifth son of Jacob and Leah, ancestor of the tribe of Issachar in the Jezreel valley.

name: Jacob
description: Son of Isaac, renamed Israel after wrestling with an angel, whose twelve sons became the ancestors of the Twelve Tribes.

name: Jahaziel
description: Levite on whom the Spirit came, assuring Jehoshaphat that the battle against Moab and Ammon was the Lord's.

name: James (brother of Jesus)
description: Brother of Jesus and leader of the Jerusalem church, traditionally the author of the Epistle of James.

name: James, son of Alphaeus
description: One of the Twelve, often identified with James the Less.

name: James, son of Zebedee
description: Fisherman and one of the inner circle of three, the first apostle to be martyred, under Herod Agrippa.

name: Jared
description: Son of Mahalalel and father of Enoch, said to have lived 962 years.

name: Jeconiah
description: King of Judah who reigned three months before being carried into exile in Babylon.

name: Jeduthun
description: Levite musician and seer appointed by David to lead worship, named in the titles of several Psalms.

name: Jehoahaz of Israel
description: Son of Jehu whose reign saw Israel oppressed by the Syrians.

name: Jehoahaz of Judah
description: Son of Josiah who reigned three months before being deposed by Pharaoh Necho and taken to Egypt.

name: Jehoash of Israel
description: King of Israel who recovered cities from Syria and defeated Amaziah of Judah.

name: Jehoash of Judah
description: King of Judah, hidden as an infant from Athaliah, who repaired the Temple under the guidance of Jehoiada.

name: Jehoiakim
description: King of Judah who burned Jeremiah's scroll and became a vassal of Nebuchadnezzar.

name: Jehoram of Israel
description: Son of Ahab who campaigned against Moab and was killed by Jehu.

name: Jehoram of Judah
description: Son of Jehoshaphat who married Athaliah, daughter of Ahab, and led Judah into idolatry.

name: Jehoshaphat
description: God-fearing king of Judah who allied with Ahab and reformed the administration of justice.

name: Jehu
description: Army commander anointed king of Israel who overthrew the house of Ahab and destroyed Baal worship.

name: Jehu (prophet)
description: Son of Hanani who prophesied against Baasha of Israel and rebuked Jehoshaphat of Judah.

name: Jeremiah
description: Major prophet who warned Judah of the Babylonian conquest and witnessed the fall of Jerusalem.

name: Jeroboam I
description: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel, who set up golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

name: Jeroboam II
description: King of Israel whose long and prosperous reign restored its borders, the setting for Amos and Hosea.

name: Jesse
description: Bethlehemite father of King David, whose 'root' became a messianic symbol.

name: Jesus Christ
description: Central figure of Christianity, born in Bethlehem and raised in Nazareth, whose ministry, crucifixion and resurrection form the heart of the Gospels.

name: Jezebel
description: Phoenician princess and queen of Israel who championed Baal worship and persecuted the prophets of the Lord.

name: Joel
description: Minor prophet who described a devastating plague of locusts and foretold the outpouring of the Spirit on all flesh.

name: John Gaddi
description: Eldest son of Mattathias, killed by the Jambrites near Medeba.

name: John Hyrcanus
description: Son of Simon Thassi, Hasmonean High Priest and ruler who expanded Judaea's territory.

name: John Mark
description: Cousin of Barnabas who accompanied Paul on his first journey, often identified with the Evangelist Mark.

name: John the Apostle
description: Son of Zebedee and one of the inner circle, traditionally the Beloved Disciple and author of the Fourth Gospel.

name: John the Baptist
description: Forerunner of Jesus who preached repentance and baptised in the Jordan, later beheaded by Herod Antipas.

name: Jonah
description: Prophet sent to Nineveh who fled by sea and was swallowed by a great fish before preaching repentance to the city.

name: Jonathan Apphus
description: Son of Mattathias who succeeded Judas as leader of the revolt and became High Priest.

name: Joseph (husband of Mary)
description: Carpenter of Nazareth descended from David, husband of Mary and legal father of Jesus.

name: Joseph (son of Jacob)
description: Favoured son of Jacob and Rachel, sold into slavery by his brothers, who rose to govern Egypt; his sons founded two tribes.

name: Joseph of Arimathea
description: Wealthy council member who provided his own tomb for the burial of Jesus.

name: Joses (brother of Jesus)
description: One of the brothers of Jesus named in the Gospels of Mark and Matthew.

name: Joshua
description: Successor of Moses who led the Israelites across the Jordan and into the conquest of Canaan, including the fall of Jericho.

name: Josiah
description: Reforming king of Judah who restored the Law after it was found in the Temple and died at Megiddo.

name: Jotham
description: Son of Uzziah who governed Judah during his father's illness and built the upper gate of the Temple.

name: Judah
description: Fourth son of Jacob and Leah, ancestor of the royal tribe of Judah from which David descended.

name: Judas Iscariot
description: Apostle who betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver.

name: Judas Maccabeus
description: Son of Mattathias who led the revolt against the Seleucids and rededicated the Temple, commemorated at Hanukkah.

name: Jude (brother of Jesus)
description: Brother of Jesus traditionally regarded as the author of the Epistle of Jude.

name: Jude the Apostle
description: Apostle called Judas son of James, also known as Thaddeus or Lebbaeus.

name: Judith
description: Widow of Bethulia who saved her people by beheading the Assyrian general Holofernes.

name: Kenan
description: Son of Enos and one of the antediluvian patriarchs in the line from Adam to Noah.

name: Lamech (father of Noah)
description: Son of Methuselah and father of Noah, who foretold that his son would bring comfort from the toil of the cursed ground.

name: Lazarus
description: Friend of Jesus from Bethany whom Jesus raised from the dead after four days.

name: Levi
description: Third son of Jacob and Leah, ancestor of the priestly tribe of Levi.

name: Luke the Evangelist
description: Physician and companion of Paul, traditionally the author of the Gospel of Luke and the Acts of the Apostles.

name: Mahalalel
description: Son of Kenan and antediluvian patriarch, said to have lived 895 years.

name: Malachi
description: Last of the minor prophets, who foretold the sending of a messenger and the return of Elijah.

name: Manasseh (son of Joseph)
description: Elder son of Joseph, ancestor of the tribe of Manasseh settled on both sides of the Jordan.

name: Manasseh of Judah
description: Longest-reigning king of Judah, notorious for idolatry, who later repented in captivity.

name: Mark the Evangelist
description: Companion of Peter, traditionally the author of the Gospel of Mark.

name: Martha
description: Sister of Lazarus and Mary of Bethany who welcomed Jesus into her home.

name: Mary Magdalene
description: Follower of Jesus from Magdala who witnessed the crucifixion and was first to see the risen Christ.

name: Mary of Bethany
description: Sister of Martha and Lazarus who sat at Jesus' feet and anointed him with costly ointment.

name: Mary of Clopas
description: Woman who stood by the cross of Jesus, described as the wife of Clopas.

name: Mary, mother of Jesus
description: Virgin of Nazareth who conceived Jesus by the Holy Spirit and stood at the foot of the cross.

name: Mattathias
description: Priest of Modein whose refusal to offer pagan sacrifice sparked the Maccabean revolt.

name: Matthew
description: Tax collector called by Jesus to be an apostle, traditionally the author of the first Gospel.

name: Matthias
description: Disciple chosen by lot to replace Judas Iscariot among the Twelve.

name: Medad
description: Elder who prophesied alongside Eldad in the camp during the wilderness journey.

name: Menahem
description: King of Israel who paid tribute to the Assyrian king Pul to secure his throne.

name: Methuselah
description: Son of Enoch and grandfather of Noah, the longest-lived person in the Bible at 969 years.

name: Micah
description: Minor prophet of Judah who foretold that a ruler would come forth from Bethlehem.

name: Micaiah
description: Prophet who alone foretold Ahab's defeat and death at Ramoth-gilead.

name: Miriam
description: Sister of Moses and Aaron, a prophetess who led the women in song after the crossing of the Red Sea.

name: Mordecai
description: Benjamite at the Persian court in Shushan who, with his cousin Esther, foiled Haman's plot against the Jews.

name: Moses
description: Prophet and lawgiver who led the Israelites out of slavery in Egypt and received the Law on Mount Sinai.

name: Nadab of Israel
description: Son of Jeroboam who reigned two years before being assassinated by Baasha.

name: Nahor (son of Serug)
description: Son of Serug and grandfather of Abraham.

name: Nahshon
description: Prince of the tribe of Judah during the wilderness wanderings, traditionally the first to enter the Red Sea.

name: Nahum
description: Minor prophet who foretold the fall of Nineveh.

name: Naphtali
description: Son of Jacob and Bilhah, ancestor of the tribe of Naphtali in Galilee.

name: Nathan
description: Prophet at David's court who rebuked the king over Bathsheba and helped secure Solomon's succession.

name: Nehemiah
description: Cupbearer to Artaxerxes who became governor of Judah and rebuilt the walls of Jerusalem.

name: Nicodemus
description: Pharisee who came to Jesus by night and later helped bury him.

name: Noah
description: Righteous patriarch who built the ark to save his family and the animals from the Great Flood, receiving the covenant of the rainbow.

name: Obadiah
description: Minor prophet whose short book pronounces judgement on Edom.

name: Obed
description: Son of Boaz and Ruth and grandfather of King David.

name: Oded
description: Prophet in Samaria who persuaded the army of Israel to release captives taken from Judah.

name: Omri
description: Army commander who became king of Israel, founded Samaria as its capital and established a powerful dynasty.

name: Onesimus
description: Runaway slave of Philemon converted through Paul and sent back as a brother in Christ.

name: Paul
description: Pharisee of Tarsus converted on the road to Damascus, Apostle to the Gentiles and author of many New Testament letters.

name: Pekah
description: King of Israel who allied with Rezin of Syria against Judah.

name: Pekahiah
description: Son of Menahem, assassinated by his officer Pekah.

name: Peleg
description: Son of Eber, in whose days the earth was divided.

name: Perez
description: Son of Judah and Tamar, ancestor of King David.

name: Peter
description: Galilean fisherman and leader of the Twelve, who denied Jesus three times and became the rock of the early Church.

name: Philemon
description: Christian of Colossae to whom Paul wrote on behalf of Onesimus.

name: Philip II of Macedon
description: King of Macedon and father of Alexander the Great.

name: Philip the Apostle
description: Apostle from Bethsaida who brought Nathanael to Jesus.

name: Philip the Tetrarch
description: Son of Herod the Great and tetrarch of Ituraea and Trachonitis, founder of Caesarea Philippi.

name: Phinehas
description: Grandson of Aaron whose zeal at Peor earned a covenant of perpetual priesthood.

name: Pontius Pilate
description: Roman prefect of Judaea who sentenced Jesus to crucifixion.

name: Priscilla
description: Wife of Aquila and fellow worker of Paul, who instructed Apollos.

name: Quirinius
description: Roman governor of Syria associated with the census at the time of Jesus' birth.

name: Ram
description: Son of Hezron and ancestor of David in the tribe of Judah.

name: Rehoboam
description: Son of Solomon whose harsh policy caused the northern tribes to secede, leaving him king of Judah alone.

name: Reu
description: Son of Peleg and ancestor of Abraham.

name: Reuben
description: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah, ancestor of the tribe of Reuben east of the Jordan.

name: Ruth
description: Moabite widow who remained loyal to her mother-in-law Naomi, married Boaz and became great-grandmother of David.

name: Salmon
description: Son of Nahshon and, according to Matthew, husband of Rahab and father of Boaz.

name: Salome
description: Daughter of Herodias whose dance before Herod Antipas led to the execution of John the Baptist.

name: Samson
description: Nazirite judge of Israel of legendary strength, betrayed by Delilah to the Philistines.

name: Samuel
description: Last of the judges and a great prophet, who anointed both Saul and David as kings of Israel.

name: Sarah
description: Wife of Abraham and mother of Isaac, born to her in old age; first of the matriarchs.

name: Saul
description: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel, whose reign ended in defeat and death on Mount Gilboa.

name: Serug
description: Son of Reu and great-grandfather of Abraham.

name: Seth
description: Third son of Adam and Eve, born after the death of Abel, through whom the line to Noah descends.

name: Shallum
description: Assassin of Zechariah who reigned only one month before being killed by Menahem.

name: Shelah
description: Son of Arphaxad (or Cainan) and father of Eber in the post-Flood genealogy.

name: Shem
description: Eldest son of Noah, ancestor of the Semitic peoples and of Abraham.

name: Shemaiah
description: Prophet who warned Rehoboam not to make war against the northern tribes.

name: Silas
description: Leader of the Jerusalem church who accompanied Paul on his second missionary journey.

name: Simeon
description: Second son of Jacob and Leah, ancestor of the tribe of Simeon in southern Judah.

name: Simeon (Gospel of Luke)
description: Devout man of Jerusalem who held the infant Jesus in the Temple and spoke the Nunc Dimittis.

name: Simon (brother of Jesus)
description: One of the brothers of Jesus, traditionally a later leader of the church in Jerusalem.

name: Simon Thassi
description: Son of Mattathias who became High Priest and ruler of Judaea, founding the Hasmonean dynasty.

name: Simon the Zealot
description: Apostle called the Zealot or the Canaanite.

name: Solomon
description: Son of David famed for his wisdom and wealth, who built the First Temple in Jerusalem.

name: Sopater
description: Christian of Berea who accompanied Paul to Asia.

name: Stephen
description: One of the seven deacons and the first Christian martyr, stoned in Jerusalem.

name: Susanna
description: Virtuous wife falsely accused by two elders and vindicated by the young Daniel.

name: Terah
description: Father of Abraham, Nahor and Haran, who led his family from Ur of the Chaldees towards Canaan before dying in Haran.

name: Thomas
description: Apostle called Didymus who doubted the resurrection until he touched Jesus' wounds.

name: Tiberius
description: Roman emperor during the ministry and crucifixion of Jesus.

name: Tibni
description: Rival claimant to the throne of Israel who contested Omri's rule for several years.

name: Timothy
description: Young disciple from Lystra and Paul's close companion, recipient of two pastoral letters.

name: Titus
description: Gentile companion of Paul, left in Crete to organise the church there.

name: Tobit
description: Righteous exile in Nineveh struck blind, whose son Tobias journeys with the angel Raphael.

name: Tubal-cain
description: Descendant of Cain and son of Lamech, described as the forger of instruments of bronze and iron.

name: Uriah (prophet)
description: Prophet who prophesied alongside Jeremiah and was executed by King Jehoiakim.

name: Uzziah
description: King of Judah whose long reign brought prosperity, struck with leprosy for burning incense in the Temple.

name: Zebulun
description: Sixth son of Jacob and Leah, ancestor of the tribe of Zebulun in lower Galilee.

name: Zechariah (father of John the Baptist)
description: Priest struck mute after doubting Gabriel's announcement of the birth of his son, John the Baptist.

name: Zechariah (prophet)
description: Post-exilic prophet whose visions encouraged the rebuilding of the Temple and looked to a humble king riding on a donkey.

name: Zechariah ben Jehoiada
description: Priest and prophet stoned in the Temple court at the command of King Joash.

name: Zechariah of Israel
description: Son of Jeroboam II, last of the house of Jehu, assassinated after six months.

name: Zedekiah
description: Last king of Judah, whose rebellion against Babylon led to the destruction of Jerusalem in 587 BC.

name: Zephaniah
description: Minor prophet in the days of Josiah who proclaimed the coming Day of the Lord.

name: Zimri
description: Chariot commander who murdered Elah and reigned for only seven days before dying in the burning palace.
